fixed_source: Annales Henri Lebesgue 6 (2023), pp. 767-845, publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.178
author_hypotheses: Dimension two; normalized far-field modulus one and f(1)=0; throughout-paper f prime(1)>0; f C3 near one and Gamma!=0; sound speed and rescaled lump exactly as defined by the author. p in (1,infinity], epsilon small depending on p; C1 branch on positive epsilon interval, not smoothness at epsilon=0.
main_result: Original Theorem1.3 mainTH in full, including existence, W1,p/W1,p+1 convergence, Hamilton group relation and original leading energy/momentum/action asymptotics.
proof_inputs: Cited lump nondegeneracy is retained as an input, not independently reproved or certified. Symmetry subspaces and all kernel/weighted estimates retained with original normalizations and restrictions.
extensions: Euler–Korteweg Theorem mainTH_EK and all original g/kappa hypotheses remain complete original context; the authors Section5 extra-term estimate and reuse of Sections4.5/4.6 are kept at the printed granularity, not expanded or independently counted. General nondegenerate KP solitary-wave remark retains its conditional decay/kernel assumptions. Numerical ground-state uniqueness/eigenvalue observations remain numerical or presumptive statements, not new theorems.
collection_gap: Independent chiron.bib not collected; full references remain readable in the original publisher PDF. Publisher class/macros are environment resources, not missing author proof.
